title: MathaMAGICal: Validating Trajectory Data Attribution During Capability Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2611.19692v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Influence-function-based methods like MAGIC provide exact first-order scores for trajectory data attribution, yet only retraining indicates whether those scores accurately predict data removal. We evaluate MAGIC on $86$M- and $152$M-parameter GPT-2-style models learning multistep arithmetic from scratch on filtered web text and four synthetic math families. Full-run attribution at $86$M suffers from numerical overflow, and even with metagradient clipping, scores correlate near chance with retraining (linear datamodeling score, LDS, $0.17$--$0.22$). In contrast, short checkpoint windows yield stable, accurate predictions at both scales (LDS $0.86$--$0.99$ across four $100$-step windows at $152$M), whereas a single-checkpoint gradient-dot baseline shows near-zero correlation. translated_title: MathaMAGICal：在能力获取过程中验证轨迹数据归因
translated_abstract: 基于影响函数的方法（如MAGIC）为轨迹数据归因提供精确的一阶分数，但只有重新训练才能表明这些分数能否准确预测移除数据的效果。我们在8600万和1.52亿参数的GPT-2风格模型上评估了MAGIC，这些模型在过滤后的网络文本和四个合成数学数据集上从零开始学习多步算术。在8600万参数规模下，完整训练过程的归因存在数值溢出问题，即使采用元梯度裁剪，分数与重新训练结果的相关性也接近随机水平（线性数据建模分数LDS为0.17-0.22）。相比之下，短检查点窗口在两个模型规模上都能产生稳定且准确的预测（在1.52亿参数规模下的四个100步窗口中LDS为0.86-0.99），而单检查点梯度点积基线则显示出接近于零的相关性。单个训练块的排名仅在单次运行内能够预测重新训练结果，且无法在不同随机种子或超参数之间迁移（ρ ≤ 0.09）……
tldr: 该研究发现基于MAGIC的短检查点窗口轨迹数据归因分数能在两个模型规模上准确预测重新训练结果（LDS达0.86-0.99），而完整运行归因存在数值溢出且接近随机水平，且归因排名无法跨随机种子或超参数迁移。
en_tdlr: Short checkpoint-window MAGIC attribution scores accurately predict retraining outcomes at both model scales (LDS 0.86-0.99), while full-run attribution suffers from numerical overflow and near-chance correlation, and attribution rankings do not transfer across seeds or hyperparameters.
